sentence: Namastay to everyone who smesh; linger only for those who do.

wombos.definition: A multilingual farewell blending the Hindi goodbye 'Namaste,' the English word 'stay,' and the Spanish/English term of endearment 'baby' — used as a single all-in-one goodbye to a mixed-language group.
wombos.example: I waved to the whole crew and said, 'Namastay, baby.'

wombos.definition: To emit a pleasing odor; to smell fresh and clean.
wombos.example: My twuh told me I smesh, which was a relief after that beast.
